sources.title: A trip down Market Street before the fire
sources.author: Miles Brothers
sources.spec: LoC access mp4, 1440×1080, 24 fps, 579.5 s, 226 536 580 bytes; make.sh cuts 455–480 s into data/clips/market.mp4 (H.264, no audio). The transfer runs at about 0.87× (LoC notes: 8:23 at about 15 fps), so the plates play it at 1.15×.
sources.credit: A trip down Market Street before the fire (Miles Brothers, 1906). Library of Congress, Motion Picture, Broadcasting, and Recorded Sound Division, Before and After the Great Earthquake and Fire: Early Films of San Francisco, 1897 to 1916 Collection. Public domain.
sources.note: Facts on the cards come from the LoC record: filmed 14 April 1906, four days before the earthquake and fire of 18 April 1906.
